action.message:
Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In `ModelAdmin.changelist_view`, the list_editable POST bulk-edit processing (the loop that saves each changed form via `save_form`/`save_model`/`save_related`/`log_change`) is now wrapped in `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`. This ensures the whole bulk edit commits or rolls back atomically, preventing unexpected partial states on error. `transaction` and `router` were already imported from `django.db`.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (`admin_changelist`) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
